defect_a.name: MULTI_OUTPUT_STALENESS_MASKED
defect_a.root_cause: evaluate() took _newest() over every file produced by a stage and compared that maximum against the newest input. On a stage declaring more than one output, a fresher sibling won the max and hid an artifact genuinely older than its own input.

baseline_harm_measured.method: identical synthetic workspace driven through the real CLI on both trees
baseline_harm_measured.consequence: The baseline walked the owner past a Master Keyword List that never saw its Cerebro data and told them to build keyword intelligence on it. Stages 6, 8, 9 and 10 all consume that list.

fix.rule: each declared output PATTERN contributes its newest match; the MINIMUM is taken ACROSS patterns
deliberately_preserved: One pattern contributes one artifact; the minimum is never taken across every file on disk, so a superseded Cerebro export the owner never deleted does not mark stage 4 stale for ever.
artifact now names the OLDEST output - the file the owner must look at. Naming the fresh sibling sent them to a file that was fine.
Equal mtimes are READY, not STALE. Strict '<'. An engine writing inside one clock tick of its input is the normal fast case; a permanent false STALE is worse. Pinned in revision 2.
fix.docstring_updated: The module's staleness rule read 'output mtime < input mtime', the exact ambiguity that permitted the defect. It now reads 'OLDEST output mtime < newest input mtime' and says why.
fix.renamed_in_revision_2: Was _oldest_output. Review C2: the name described something the function never did - it does not return the oldest matching file, it returns the oldest of the per-pattern NEWEST matches.

defect_b.name: OWNER_COMMAND_RENDERING_NOT_PASTE_SAFE
defect_b.separable: git revert fcd6d31 removes it without touching DEFECT A
defect_b.audit_finding: A seed of 'nurse"; calc; #' printed as --seed "nurse"; calc; #", which a shell splits at the second quote.

additional_instance_found_during_fix.name: PLACEHOLDER_PRINTED_WITH_BARE_CMD_REDIRECTION_OPERATORS
additional_instance_found_during_fix.detail: <seed-keyword>, printed whenever no --seed is supplied, went out with < and > bare. Those are cmd.exe redirection operators: pasted as printed, the line does not run the command, it truncates a file named seed-keyword and reads from it. It is also the one line guaranteed to be pasted by a first-time owner.

fix.rule: single-quoted PowerShell literal; '' is the only escape; a leading - also forces quoting; bare only for [A-Za-z0-9._+=/:\-\\]
fix.not_proven: The printed commands have NOT been executed in the shell they name. pwsh is not available on this clone. Windows-side evidence, blocking.

defect_found_in_revision_1_own_fix.name: POWERSHELL_DOUBLE_QUOTE_EXPANDS_DOLLAR
defect_found_in_revision_1_own_fix.detail: Revision 1 quoted with DOUBLE quotes and doubled embedded quotes - correct for the Microsoft C runtime argv parser, wrong for PowerShell, where a double-quoted string still expands $. A seed of 'nurse $5 gift' would have reached the engine as 'nurse  gift': silent value corruption, the exact failure class the function exists to prevent.
defect_found_in_revision_1_own_fix.why_revision_1_tests_missed_it: Not one of them contained a $.
defect_found_in_revision_1_own_fix.found_by: Complying with review C4 - committing to ONE named shell. The review did not name this defect; insisting on a single target surfaced it.

audit_soundness_findings_reverified.revision_1_weakness: A bare-call-name AST scan produces false positives such as str.replace and can miss a dynamically resolved write. Revision 1 disclosed its false positive but still presented the scan as if it settled the question. It did not.
audit_soundness_findings_reverified.runtime_filesystem_diff: test_the_cli_touches_no_file_in_the_workspace - recursive (size, mtime_ns) snapshot either side of a real subprocess run of the CLI over a populated workspace. Load-bearing: an AST scan can be fooled, a diff around the actual process cannot.
audit_soundness_findings_reverified.receiver_qualified_ast_scan: test_no_qualified_write_or_exec_call_exists - classifies os.replace and str.replace differently, so the false positive can no longer wave a real one through.
audit_soundness_findings_reverified.os_surface_check: test_only_read_only_os_functions_are_used - usage must stay within {listdir, path}

output_pattern_semantics.why_it_matters: The staleness minimum is only correct if every declared output is a required current artifact. An optional pattern in the same flat list would produce a false STALE.
output_pattern_semantics.proved_by: test_every_declared_output_is_required - behavioural, against the SHIPPED table: each output of each multi-output stage is removed in turn and must stop the stage being READY.
output_pattern_semantics.missing_required_output: reports MISSING or BLOCKED and never reaches a staleness verdict; evaluate() resolves missing_outputs BEFORE any timestamp compare
output_pattern_semantics.equal_mtime_boundary: READY, deliberately. An engine writing inside one clock tick of its input is the normal fast case; a permanent false STALE is worse. Strict '<'. Pinned by test_equal_mtimes_are_ready_not_stale.
